flash_692323.description: US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth says Washington is not ruling out military strikes against Iran despite its new campaign of economic pressure.

flash_692325.description: The Trump administration removes Syria from the US terror list, easing sanctions and opening the door to investment and reintegration into global markets.

flash_692324.description:
IDF surveillance systems detected suspicious movement along the eastern border in the Jordan Valley area on Monday evening.

IDF forces are conducting searches in the area to rule out a border crossing, while roads in the vicinity are being blocked as troops work to locate the suspects.

flash_692327.description: Iran's economy minister says Tehran has a two-year plan to counter new US sanctions after Washington announces a sweeping economic campaign.

flash_692326.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported a maritime incident approximately nine nautical miles northeast of Oman, during which an oil tanker was struck by an unidentified missile. The impact damaged the tanker’s engine room, but no crew members were injured.

According to the organization, the environmental impact of the incident is not yet known.

flash_692331.description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed distances his campaign from Hasan Piker after the streamer’s remarks about Jewish Americans spark renewed controversy.

flash_692330.description: Palestinian Arab media reported early Tuesday that the IDF carried out a strike in central Gaza.

flash_692328.description:
Two men were seriously and moderately injured in a shooting in Baka al-Gharbiyyeh. Magen David Adom (MDA) medics and paramedics evacuated them to Hillel Yaffe Hospital in Hadera.

Police forces are at the scene, collecting evidence and investigating the incident. The shooting is believed to have been criminally motivated.

flash_692334.description: MK Tzvi Sukkot visits scene where an Israeli reservist was attacked by PA police officers, calls on defense establishment to bring those involved to justice.

flash_692333.description: US State Department is offering up to $10 million and possible relocation for information on five senior Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commanders.

flash_692329.description: New poll examines a scenario in which Ofer Winter’s party runs independently. In that scenario, the Religious Zionist Party fails to cross the electoral threshold and the right-wing bloc falls to 49 seats.

flash_692336.description: A Syrian court sentences former grand mufti Ahmed Hassoun to life in prison after convicting him of inciting civil war and intentional killing.

flash_692335.description: The Netherlands will skip Eurovision 2027, claiming the Gaza war and Israel's participation have undermined the contest's political neutrality.

flash_692332.description: Unity Party chairman Gilad Erdan and Col. (res.) Hezi Nechama tour the Gaza border area following the renewed launch of explosive kites, call for a change in policy.

flash_692338.description: Mark Ruffalo once admitted the “Genocide" libel fuels antisemitism. Now he’s doing it again? Opinion.

flash_692337.description: What happens when the custodian of memory alters it? Archaeology does not change its nature according to who operates the excavator.

flash_692341.description: After Oct 7 the government of South Africa lost no time dragging Israel to The Hague for genocide in Gaza. It also got bosom buddy Hamas which had dragged slain IDF Capt Daniel Perez to Gaza, to return his mortal remains to the mother and father, who happens to be President of the World Zionist Organisation.

flash_692340.description: Three people wearing coveralls and headlamps were caught on video climbing out of a Manhattan sewer at 4 a.m., raising fresh questions about a string of mysterious underground incidents across New York City.

flash_692339.description: Pakistan says ‘significant progress’ was made in Tehran talks on the Iran-US conflict, regional tensions, reopening the Strait of Hormuz and a settlement.

flash_692342.description: Mossad Director Roman Gofman has thrown his support behind a disputed plan for a 200-dunam industrial zone near Bir Hadaj, arguing that jobs could strengthen security and weaken criminal elements.

flash_692346.description: While Rabbi Kook emphasizes that the teshuva of the Jewish People and a return to the Torah go hand-in-hand, he indicates that a preliminary stage of national revival will bring this spiritual awakening to pass.

flash_692345.description: The study of Torah, through which the spiritual world is sustained, is carried out by Torah scholars and by all Jews who set aside regular times for Torah study.

flash_692343.description: Military Police officers in civilian clothes raided a family home in Haifa late at night and arrested a 22-year-old yeshiva graduate.

flash_692351.description:
Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar criticized MK Zvi Sukkot, stressing that decisions in Judea and Samaria must be made and implemented solely by the state, the IDF, and the security forces.

“This is also the message that elected officials should convey to the public. Unfortunately, MK Sukkot knowingly did the opposite," he said.

flash_692350.description: MK Ohad Tal criticized fellow Religious Zionist Party MK Tzvi Sukkot for entering Arab villages to destroy monuments to terrorists. In internal Religious Zionist Party groups, he wrote: “I want to understand - was this move coordinated with the campaign? Is there some deep strategy behind it that I am completely missing, or have we simply decided to commit political suicide once and for all? I’m genuinely asking."

flash_692347.description: Washington is moving to isolate Iran from the global economy, threatening sanctions against entities that continue trading with Tehran.

flash_692344.description: MK Tzvi Sukkot takes a sledgehammer to monuments honoring terrorists near Yitzhar, saying authorities failed to act despite his earlier demands.

flash_692352.description: IDF officials clarified on Tuesday morning that plans had been drawn up to demolish the monument smashed by MK Sukkot in the village of Madama, near Yitzhar, and that the operation was scheduled to take place in the coming weeks. “Dozens of similar monuments have already been demolished in Judea and Samaria, and an operation to demolish this monument legally and in an orderly manner by the security forces was scheduled to take place in the coming weeks. Preliminary inspections were also conducted by the Samaria Brigade ahead of the demolition of monuments," the officials said.

flash_692349.description: IDF, Israel Police, and Jerusalem Municipality began evacuating the UNRWA in Kafr Aqab.

flash_692348.description: Gaza envelope residents block aid trucks outside the international force base at Kerem Shalom, warning against rebuilding Gaza before Hamas is disarmed.

flash_692357.description: IDF launches series of strikes targeting five Hamas weapon storage facilities and a launch site inside mosques and alongside humanitarian infrastructure in the Gaza Strip.

flash_692356.description: Official figures show a sharp decline in Arab recruitment to the Israel Police, as ministry officials point to stricter vetting and Hebrew requirements.

flash_692355.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu criticized MK Tzvi Sukkot for entering Arab villages in Samaria to destroy monuments to terrorists, saying the MK took the law into his own hands.

“The IDF is the sovereign authority in Judea and Samaria and is responsible for implementing the decisions of the political echelon. Taking the law into one’s own hands, particularly by public officials, is unacceptable and prevents the IDF from focusing on its missions against terrorism and incitement," Netanyahu stated.

flash_692353.description: Hours before Manor Solomon was set to face fellow Israeli Daniel Peretz, pro-Palestinian activists protested outside West Ham's training ground and demanded the club release the Israeli star.

flash_692360.description:
US President Donald Trump addressed the economic situation in Iran amid increasing US sanctions and condemned the regime for executing protesters.

"The failing Islamic Republic of Iran is not paying large segments of their military, while at the same time killing protesters, even when they are not protesting, at levels not seen before. It is a humanitarian crisis of epic proportions, and must be stopped," he wrote on Truth Social.

flash_692359.description: Sovereignty Movement co-chair speaks to Arutz Sheva at demonstration outside ISF base, calls to cancel agreement and restore Israeli sovereignty and Jewish settlement in Gaza.

flash_692358.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich said the terror memorial should have been removed long ago, but insisted that only the IDF has the authority to carry out such actions.

flash_692354.description:
Religious Zionist Party chairman Bezalel Smotrich reprimanded MK Tzvi Sukkot for entering Palestinian Arab villages to destroy monuments to terrorists.

Smotrich told Sukkot that the proper course is to act with authorization and within the bounds of one’s authority, “as is done on matters concerning Judea and Samaria communities," and demanded that he not do anything like this again.

flash_692364.description: Defense Minister visits IDF troops at the summit of Mount Hermon and sends a message to Damascus: “As long as there are threats, the IDF will remain here."

flash_692363.description: Prime Minister Netnayhu stated: "In accordance with my directive and following the law we passed, the evacuation of the UNRWA compound in Kafr Aqab, Jerusalem, began today. The State of Israel will not allow an organization whose employees were complicit in terrorism and the October 7 massacre to operate within its territory, and will act against it by all means at its disposal."

flash_692362.description: A swastika was sprayed on the road on Yakinton Street in the Gilo neighborhood of Jerusalem this morning. Sanitation officials removed the symbol, and residents called on the police to check the security cameras in the area and locate those responsible for the act.

flash_692371.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir says IDF will continue dismantling Hamas and demilitarizing Gaza: ‘Those who took part in the 10/7 massacre will be hunted down until they are all eliminated.'

flash_692370.description:
The Board of Peace addressed the kite flying from the Gaza Strip and stated that it had conveyed, through the existing mechanism, a message that all activity by terrorist organizations in the Strip must cease, including kite flying.

Alongside this, it was stated that Israel is also committed to the terms of the ceasefire, and that military action should be limited to responding to real and immediate threats.

flash_692369.description: If only the nameless bodies buried in the red earth of the Nigerian Plateau, the children burned in the churches of Congo, the women kidnapped and disfigured in the Sahel, carried another name, another flag, another cause - we would know about them. Opinion.

flash_692367.description: The report finds a 91% chance that one of the next five years will be more than 1.5 degrees warmer than the pre-industrial period.

flash_692365.description: Israel must impose its own cost on Europe’s E1 obsession as Europe threatens Israel with sanctions in response to Israel’s plans to finally begin construction there. Opinion.

flash_692361.description: Hadar Cohen, the premature baby who was born 42 days ago following the serious car accident in which her mother, Tzofia, was killed, died today.

flash_692373.description: President Isaac Herzog told Hymanot Kassau’s family that the Shin Bet has joined the investigation and efforts to locate the 9-year-old, who has been missing for about two and a half years.

flash_692372.description: US President Donald Trump announced today that all Iranian mines have been removed from the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_692368.description: Rabbi Menachem Perl explains why routine travel on the driverless metro is prohibited on Shabbat, while distinguishing between actual travel and operating the system.

flash_692366.description: The Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Environmental Protection announced that mosquitoes carrying the West Nile fever virus were detected in 3 regional councils.

flash_692376.description: The Chief Economist updates the cost of a reservist to NIS 53,000 per month and estimates: Replacing 10,000 of them with regular soldiers would save billions.

flash_692375.description: Dr. Schleifer, expert in psychological warfare, says the seemingly innocent kites launched from Gaza are the beginning of a planned and systematic Hamas effort to acclimate Israel.

flash_692374.description: People remember those who helped them. But they usually become even more deeply attached to those who appreciated them enough to accept their help. Opinion.

flash_692377.description: Following a manhunt and intelligence guidance from the Coastal District Central Unit, Yamam officers arrested suspects in Hadera in connection with the murder of Caucasian mafia boss Yanis Yushbayev.

flash_692378.description: Brig. Gen. (res.) Ofer Winter launches 'Amcha Yisrael' party, with public diplomacy activist Yoseph Haddad at no. 2, alongside military and reserve personnel, media and legal figures, community and bereaved family members.

flash_692382.description: A special report presents quotes from ceremonies, assemblies, and events held in Palestinian Authority schools honoring the heroism of Hamas terrorists on the day of the October 7 massacre.

flash_692381.description: Leket Israel CEO Joseph Gitler discusses rescuing surplus food, supporting Israeli farmers and expanding food assistance ahead of Rosh Hashanah, with a goal of distributing more than 700,000 meals to people in need.

flash_692380.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu attacked Ofer Winter during an event hosted by the Binyamin Regional Council on Tuesday evening and called on him to unite with Moshe Feiglin and Avi Maoz.

flash_692379.description: “I Will Always Love You' singer, who dominated the country music scene for nearly 60 years, passes away at 80.

flash_692384.description: The Secret Service says it is investigating an Iranian state media video threatening Barron Trump and claiming his movements had been monitored.

flash_692383.description: The Prime Minister’s son personally addresses each candidate on Ofer Winter’s slate, warning that further fragmentation of the national camp could help the left-wing bloc.

flash_692385.description:
The Likud party announced that, following a decision by the party’s election committee, headed by retired Judge Menachem Ne’eman, ballots from the Likud primary election in Be’er Ya’akov will be recounted.

“The results will be incorporated into the final results after the appeals are heard this coming Thursday. Likud is committed to ensuring the integrity of the election process and adhering to the directives of the party’s tribunal and election committee," the party said in a statement.

flash_692388.description: Iran’s Deputy Foreign Minister says the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until key conditions are met.

flash_692387.description:
Lebanese media reported that the IDF carried out a strike overnight in Kfar Rumman, in the Nabatieh Governorate of southern Lebanon.

Additional IDF strikes were also reported in Ali al-Taher, Al-Mansouri, Zar'bin and Al-Qantara.

flash_692392.description: Toronto police are investigating an alleged antisemitic incident near Bathurst and Sheppard, an area which has seen frequent anti-Israel demonstrations.

flash_692391.description:
Representatives for country music legend Dolly Parton, who died Tuesday at the age of 80, said she passed away following a “brief battle with cancer." Parton died at Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Nashville, surrounded by her family.

The type of cancer she had was not disclosed.

flash_692390.description: Ohio man arrested after allegedly sending a death threat against Rep. Randy Fine and calling for President Trump’s death.

flash_692386.description: Axios reports Secretary of State Marco Rubio has told allies the US is not planning new Iran strikes for now, as Washington intensifies sanctions and economic pressure.

flash_692396.description: Trump sends Congress the Saudi civil nuclear deal, but says the pact will only proceed if Riyadh joins the Abraham Accords and normalizes ties with Israel.

flash_692395.description: UN chief Antonio Guterres condemns Israel’s evacuation of a UNRWA training center in Jerusalem: “It will deprive young people of education".

flash_692394.description: Federal prosecutors seek to detain Larry Montes, accused of attacking worshippers and a security guard during services at New York's Central Synagogue.

flash_692389.description:
A 37-year-old man was moderately injured in a violent incident in Haifa.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Bnei Zion Hospital in the city.

flash_692402.description:
Ukrainian media reported that Ukrainian drones hit a logistics complex of the Russian retail giant WildBreeze in the Tambov region.

The company's facilities in the province have already been damaged in previous attacks by Ukraine.

flash_692401.description:
The administration of US President Donald Trump has ordered a temporary freeze on visa appointments at US embassies and consulates around the world. The State Department said the move is intended to allow for a global training program for consular employees, aimed at improving screening and ensuring uniform evaluation of visa applicants, including regarding the possibility that they may become dependent on welfare benefits and public assistance in the United States.

According to the Financial Times, immigrant visa applicants who had already been scheduled for interviews received notices that their appointments had been postponed and were told that a new date would be set at a later time. At this stage, no timetable has been provided for the resumption of appointments.

flash_692400.description: Dear "horrified" Europeans, what would you have done if October 7 had happened to your country, your community, your wife, your daughters, your children or your grandchildren? Op-ed.

flash_692398.description: Why are they fighting Israel? Opinion.

flash_692393.description: Trump-endorsed Sen. Darline Graham wins the GOP Senate nomination in South Carolina and will face Democrat Annie Andrews in November.

flash_692410.description:
Ukrainian media reported that Ukrainian drones hit a logistics complex of the Russian retail giant Wildberries in the Tambov region.

The company's facilities in the region have been hit in previous Ukrainian strikes.

flash_692409.description: There are four languages of the redemption promised by Hashem, - for which, the four glasses of wine are drunk at the Seder - but there is a fifth promise as well. Which promise is that?

flash_692408.description:
Capitol Police in Washington, D.C., arrested a 35-year-old man from California after a guillotine was found in the bed of his pickup truck. Police said the truck was illegally parked near the Capitol complex.

According to authorities, the man was traveling from California to Washington, and investigators are looking into why he came to the city and what he intened to do with the guillotine. He was arrested on suspicion of possessing a dangerous weapon.

flash_692405.description: The farmer does not simply bring his fruit to Jerusalem. He tells a story.

flash_692404.description: Captivity survivor Rom Braslavski recounted the moment in captivity when he was forced to reveal his identity as a soldier - about six months after the murderous attack. “I realize I’m done for."

flash_692399.description: Hadash chairman Yousef Jabareen is demanding clear guarantees on the development of Arab society and combating crime, along with a clear stance against “settlements".

flash_692397.description: Montreal city council approves a revised Middle East motion, removing calls to cut ties with Israel and accusations of “genocide" and “apartheid."

flash_692416.description: A vehicle theft in Jerusalem ended overnight Wednesday with the death of the suspected thief and the light wounding of a police officer and a civilian.

flash_692415.description: Instead of prepared meals for reheating, soldiers will receive fresh, varied Mehadrin kosher food that meets stringent halachic standards.

flash_692414.description:
Prime Minister Netanyahu's son Yair was reportedly the target of the Iranian assassination plot that was revealed this week and was forced to leave for Israel as soon as the plot was uncovered.

Read more

flash_692413.description:
Lebanese media reported that Italy has proposed to establish a smaller multinational force, with UN approval, to replace UNIFIL in southern Lebanon. According to the outline, the force will focus on supporting the Lebanese army, protecting the civilian population, assisting the US-led ceasefire mechanism, and future disarmament arrangements, as well as monitoring violations and reducing escalation between Israel and Lebanon.

According to the report in Nidaa al-Watan, the success of the plan depends on resolving a number of issues that have not yet been resolved, including the command structure, the scope of the forces, the rules of engagement, the funding, the verification powers in the pilot areas, and the possibility of reactivating the ceasefire mechanism that has been suspended since March.

flash_692412.description:
A suspect in a car theft from the Katamon neighborhood in Jerusalem was killed after fleeing the police, driving against traffic and colliding with a pillar and a private vehicle at the A-Tur junction.

According to the police, during the chase the officers fired at the vehicle's wheels in an attempt to stop it. A policeman and a civilian were lightly injured. The suspect was evacuated to the hospital in critical condition while undergoing resuscitation but was later pronounced dead.

flash_692411.description: All US visa applications have been suspended by the Trump administration in an effort to combat immigration and prevent the entry of immigrants who “will require public assistance."

flash_692407.description: We are not the givers, but are merely transferring what Hashem has allotted. Happy is the one who has the merit to serve as Hashem’s delivery person.

flash_692406.description:
The administration has ordered a temporary freeze on visa appointments at American embassies and consulates around the world. The State Department said the move was intended to allow for a global training program for consular officers, in order to improve screening and ensure a uniform examination of visa applicants, among other things, regarding the possibility that they would be dependent on public assistance in the United States.

According to the Financial Times, visa applicants who had already been scheduled for interviews received notices of postponed appointments, and were informed that a new date would be set in due course. At this time, no timetable for the resumption of appointments has been announced.

flash_692403.description: The dilemma facing Washington and Jerusalem: A nuclear-capable Iran that still funds proxies from Lebanon to Yemen is not a foreign-policy result. It is a failure. What can the US do? Opinion.

flash_692417.description: Three Givati soldiers reportedly refused to board a Namer carrying a female medic, citing rabbinic instructions. All soldiers in their platoon were sentenced to 21 days of confinement.

flash_692420.description: A soldier who secured Tzvi Succot’s controversial Madma visit says troops supported the demolition and rejects claims that the tour endangered them.

flash_692419.description: A Holon resident mistakenly entered Area A in the Ramallah area and contacted the police emergency hotline. Border Police officers located his vehicle and quickly rescued him unharmed.

flash_692418.description: Security forces raided properties belonging to released terrorists who received salaries from the Palestinian Authority, seizing vehicles and tens of thousands of shekels.

flash_692421.description: UAL chairman Mansour Abbas says Israel’s Jewish identity is a reality imposed by the Jewish majority, triggering fierce attacks from Smotrich and Ben-Gvir.

flash_692423.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz vows to address controversy after yeshiva soldiers confined to base for 21 days over refusal to enter APC with female paramedic.

flash_692422.description: After weeks of intense summer heat, unusual weather system could bring double-digit rainfall and even break August records in parts of Israel.

flash_692428.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu visits the family of Yehuda Katz, the last missing soldier from Sultan Yacoub, after his remains were returned to Israel.

flash_692427.description: Shas accuses Supreme Court President Isaac Amit of mocking the haredi public after he claimed many kosher phone users also carry a regular smartphone.

flash_692426.description: AI-generated assassination video shows masked terrorist shooting Tzvi Succot, warning: 'We are waiting for you everywhere.'

flash_692425.description: Terrorists eliminated as IDF strikes Hamas position near Kamal Adwan Hospital and a school, where weapons were stored and attacks were being planned.

flash_692424.description: In a landmark ruling, a Haifa court prohibits the public sale of Holocaust artifacts, saying they should be preserved for future generations rather than sold to collectors.

flash_692431.description: US President Donald Trump says Iran’s Mojtaba Khamenei suffered serious wounds to the left side of his body but is likely still alive; praises US military and Navy operations and predicts a “very big victory."

flash_692430.description:
Earlier today (Wednesday), IDF soldiers guided by the Shin Bet apprehended a terrorist in the Ganot Junction area in Samaria after information was received regarding her intention to carry out a stabbing attack.

The terrorist was apprehended while armed with a knife and was transferred to the security forces for further handling. No injuries were reported

flash_692429.description: First poll since Ofer Winter launched Amacha Yisrael gives his party six seats, while Religious Zionism falls below the threshold and Netanyahu's bloc drops to 49.

flash_692433.description: Troops have dismantled more than 400 terror infrastructure sites and located numerous weapons, including anti-tank missiles, surface-to-air missiles, explosive devices, Kalashnikov rifles, and mortars.

flash_692432.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir shares how his wounded grandfather cried out ‘Shema Yisrael’ in battle, and tells yeshiva students that Torah strengthens the IDF’s spirit.

flash_692437.description: UN Security Council hears competing visions for Gaza as Mladenov hails Hamas disarmament agreement and Waltz sharply challenges criticism of US-backed plan.

flash_692436.description: At least 95 people killed and more than 400 missing or out of contact as massive floods sweep the Himalayan region.

flash_692435.description: The Lebanese Armed Forces arrested a Syrian national suspected of attempting to smuggle weapons across the border into Lebanon. The weapons seized included RPGs.

flash_692434.description: IDF investigation finds PA forces unlawfully detained reservist Shlomo Rosenthal at an unauthorized Area C roadblock, contradicting the initial official account.

flash_692446.description: New details reveal Givati soldiers refused to board an APC with a female paramedic despite the brigade rabbi’s approval, leading the IDF to cancel the urgent mission.

flash_692445.description: New i24NEWS poll gives Ofer Winter's new 'Amcha Yisrael' party eight seats, shows it bringing right-religious bloc to 59 seats, compared with center-left's 49.

flash_692444.description: Investigation reveals alleged loopholes allowing haredi draft evaders barred from leaving Israel to bypass border controls and board flights abroad.

flash_692442.description: Malware designed to listen and collect information was reportedly discovered on the phones of two senior staffers at Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar Party campaign.

flash_692440.description: Democrats chairman Yair Golan blames Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for MK Tzvi Succot's actions in Madama, accusing the government of endangering IDF soldiers to preserve its coalition.

flash_692438.description: Yashar Party chairman Gadi Eisenkot said in an interview with Channel 13 News that a government under his leadership would not evacuate legally established farms in Area C.

flash_692457.description:
Qatar’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Majed Al Ansari, announced that Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammed Al Thani will travel to Tehran on Thursday and meet with several senior officials.

He said the talks will focus on reducing tensions, “based on Qatar’s view that diplomacy is the right way to resolve conflicts."

flash_692456.description: The US Treasury designates UK-based Palestine Action a terrorist group, freezing its assets and barring US citizens and companies from doing business with it.

flash_692455.description: Explosions were heard in communities near the Lebanon border amid IDF activity in the area.

flash_692454.description: The FDA approves Revolution Medicines’ Rasonque for metastatic pancreatic cancer after a trial showed the drug doubled survival for patients.

flash_692453.description:
A man in his 70s was seriously injured in a shooting in Haifa and was evacuated to Rambam Hospital.

Carmel District police officers launched an investigation, collected evidence at the scene, and began searching for suspects. Police believe the shooting was criminally motivated.

flash_692452.description: The decisive question is why one society’s political, religious and media institutions repeatedly provide a ready-made target, a heroic script and communal validation for those who commit terror. Op-ed.

flash_692451.description: New haredi party unveils rabbinical committee - but one rabbi denies involvement

flash_692450.description: In a complaint demanding an investigation into journalist Ori Misgav, Yair Netanyahu claims an Iranian terror squad reached his Miami home thanks to information Misgav shared.

flash_692449.description: Degel HaTorah and Agudat Yisrael open coalition talks as disputes over top Knesset slots raise questions over whether longtime partners will run together.

flash_692448.description: Omer Adam marries Sacha Israelovich in Portofino ceremony featuring a shofar, Hassidic singer Motty Steinmetz, and separate seating for men and women.

flash_692447.description: Otzma Yehudit leader says Muchtar won't join his Knesset slate; spokesperson hits back. 'Hadar Muchtar is in Likud and will remain in Likud.'

flash_692443.description: Channel 13 poll puts Gadi Eisenkot's party in first place with 24 seats, while Ofer Winter's newly launched party falls short of the electoral threshold.

flash_692441.description: A herd belonging to a Jewish farm in the Binyamin region was suspected to have been poisoned today while grazing, using a pesticide known as Lannate.

flash_692439.description: Nine Palestinian Arab adults and minors are apprehended at Tzofim Junction as local officials demand sustained action against roadside panhandling.

flash_692469.description: Delta Air Lines will resume daily nonstop flights from New York JFK to Tel Aviv on September 6, following a review of regional security conditions.

flash_692468.description: US State Department urges governments worldwide to increase security around synagogues and Jewish communities ahead of the High Holidays.

flash_692467.description: Michigan AG Dana Nessel warns Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed is rationalizing terrorism and pushing Jewish voters away from the party.

flash_692465.description: Eisenkot says Winter had not served in the IDF’s strategic command. Winter hits back, pointing to the “containment, de-escalation and appointments" policies.

flash_692463.description: Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, accused mastermind of 9/11, will stand trial at Guantanamo in June 2028 after years of delays and legal battles.

flash_692461.description: An i24NEWS poll conducted by Direct Polls gives Likud 26 seats and Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar 23. Ofer Winter’s Amcha Yisrael wins eight seats.

flash_692459.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to visit Egypt next week, marking his first trip to the country in a decade, Al-Monitor reported.

According to China’s Foreign Ministry, the visit will be part of Xi’s diplomatic tour from August 30 to September 3, which will also include a visit to Kyrgyzstan and participation in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit. In Egypt, Xi is expected to meet with President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi.

flash_692458.description: Trump says he has no timetable for the Iran war and is “not in a hurry" to resume talks, while warning Tehran faces mounting economic pressure.

flash_692509.description: An Israeli rescue team is heading into a disaster zone where hundreds remain missing after devastating floods and landslides swept through Nepal.

flash_692508.description: Commander of the Bosnian Serb Army, who was convicted of genocide and crimes against humanity, dies at age 83 while serving a life sentence in The Hague.

flash_692507.description: The IDF struck and eliminated Ismail Mohammed Ibrahim Barim, a commander in Hamas’ military wing, who held hostages Edan Alexander, Matan Zangauker, and Avera Mengistu

flash_692505.description: Doctors in Israel have pulled off a groundbreaking medical feat, removing half of a 15-year-old cancer patient’s pelvis and replacing it with a custom 3D-printed implant designed to restore his mobility.

flash_692503.description: Moscow warns it could strike British military facilities as new intelligence reveals a growing network of Russian drone launch sites capable of reaching deep into Europe.

flash_692501.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz released the following statement: “There is no directive whatsoever to open the Erez Crossing for goods. Israel's policy in Gaza is clear and has not changed: There will be no rebuilding before the disarmament of the Hamas terrorist organization and the complete demilitarization of the Gaza Strip."

flash_692497.description: A glacier collapse created a massive torrent of water, mud, and rocks. At least 353 people have been killed and more than 1,300 remain missing in Nepal and Tibet

flash_692495.description: After rejecting request to run in primaries, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu appoints Hadar Muchtar to lead Likud's youth campaign.

flash_692493.description: IDF downs drone after Hezbollah targets soldiers in southern Lebanon security zone; no injuries reported.

flash_692491.description: Ahead of the Jewish New Year, thousands of worshippers enter Joseph’s Tomb in Shechem under IDF protection for special prayers.

flash_692489.description: Labour MPs warn that planned UK sanctions and trade restrictions targeting Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria could provoke retaliation from Trump.

flash_692487.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir orders heightened readiness ahead of holidays, warns IDF faces threats from Iran to Gaza.

flash_692485.description: MK Yinon Azoulay pledges Shas will remain with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc, rules out joining forces with Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot.

flash_692483.description: I know the title of this article will trigger almost every Jew and please every antisemite. But I say to both of you, don’t judge an article by its title. Read on and see what I mean.
